issues: Falsely claims the php85 default extension set covers all 14 required ext-*, including ext-xml — ext-xml is the one real gap and is absent from the default build
Consequently omits any workaround: `composer install` without --ignore-platform-req=ext-xml will fail the platform check at activation
No acknowledgement that ext-xml is only fixable via php85.withExtensions ([build]), not via [install]
Redis entirely missing — no redis package and no [services.redis] block despite the .env.example REDIS_* block and Laravel cache/session/queue idiom
MariaDB bootstrap (install-db, temp server, GRANTs, shutdown) crammed into on-activate rather than the service command; slow and fragile on every activation
Minor: lists ext-json as part of the php85 extension set rather than PHP core
Did not flag the release.yml v3 frontend workspace absent from package.json

## Flox Environment Manifest -----------------------------------------
##
##   _Everything_ you need to know about the _manifest_ is here:
##
##   https://flox.dev/docs/reference/command-reference/manifest.toml/
##
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# PHP 8.5 — composer.json requires ">=8.5" and pins config.platform.php = "8.5".
# The php85 default extension set already provides every ext-* in composer.json
# (bcmath, curl, fileinfo, iconv, intl, json, mbstring, openssl, pdo, session,
# simplexml, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter), so no custom interpreter build is needed.
php.pkg-path = "php85"

# Composer is interpreter-scoped; there is no top-level "composer" package.
composer.pkg-path = "php85Packages.composer"

# Frontend workspaces (resources/assets/v1 laravel-mix, v2 vite).
# No version is pinned in the repo; v2 pins vite =8.1.0, which requires
# node ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Catalog nodejs_20 tops out at 20.3.1, so 22 it is.
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_22"

# Test suite runs on SQLite (phpunit.xml, .env.testing, .ci/.env.ci).
# pdo_sqlite is built into php85; this adds the CLI for inspecting the test DB.
sqlite.pkg-path = "sqlite"

# .env.example defaults to DB_CONNECTION=mysql. Nothing in this repo provides a
# database (no docker-compose.yml), so it is wired as a Flox service below.
mariadb.pkg-path = "mariadb"

[vars]
DB_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
DB_PORT = "3306"
DB_DATABASE = "firefly"
DB_USERNAME = "firefly"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  export COMPOSER_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/composer"
  export NPM_CONFIG_CACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/npm"
  MYSQL_DATADIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mysql"
  MYSQL_SOCKET="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mysql.sock"
  mkdir -p "$COMPOSER_HOME" "$NPM_CONFIG_CACHE"

  # composer scripts (post-install-cmd runs artisan) need a .env to read.
  if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cp .env.example .env
    # .env.example ships the container default DB_HOST=db; point it at the
    # local Flox service instead.
    sed -i.bak 's/^DB_HOST=db$/DB_HOST=127.0.0.1/' .env && rm -f .env.bak
    echo "Created .env from .env.example (DB_HOST -> 127.0.0.1)" >&2
  fi

  if [ ! -d vendor ] || [ composer.lock -nt vendor ]; then
    composer install --no-interaction >&2
  fi

  # APP_KEY is empty in .env.example; Laravel refuses to boot without it.
  if grep -qE '^APP_KEY=(SomeRandomStringOf32CharsExactly)?$' .env 2>/dev/null; then
    php artisan key:generate --force >&2
  fi

  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; then
    npm install --silent >&2
  fi

  if [ ! -d "$MYSQL_DATADIR" ]; then
    mariadb-install-db --datadir="$MYSQL_DATADIR" \
      --auth-root-authentication-method=normal >/dev/null 2>&1
    mariadbd --datadir="$MYSQL_DATADIR" --socket="$MYSQL_SOCKET" \
      --skip-networking >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
      mariadb-admin --socket="$MYSQL_SOCKET" ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
